title: Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Networking component
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-12297 affects Microsoft software version 4.0, involving a sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Networking component. This flaw could potentially allow an attacker to break out of a restricted execution environment. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. No known exploits are reported in the wild, and no patch or remediation details are available.
